rows: What fraction of fixed carbon reaches sediment?
DOC → bacteria → flagellates → ciliates; remineralizes most carbon in photic zone
What limits production in the Southern Ocean?
Eastern boundary upwelling systems — four coastal zones producing ~20% of fish catch
What does El Niño do to marine productivity?
Warms and deepens thermocline → shuts off upwelling → productivity collapse
Ultra-low chlorophyll — dominated by tiny Prochlorococcus; nutrients absent
Export of organic carbon from surface to deep via sinking particles and migrants
How much of ocean is "high productivity"?
<5% of ocean area (coastal, upwelling, polar zones)
